conteudo: Good as New Craft one weapon of each type. Better than New Upgrade one weapon of each type. Avenger Complete 6 or more of Brynn’s feats. Shadow Complete 6 or more of Chance’s feats. Huntsman Complete 6 or more of Galaden’s feats. Crafter Complete 6 or more of Kehli’s feats. Prodigy Complete 6 or more of Syrus’s feats. Outcast Complete 6 or more of Vaerix’s feats. Speed of Fight As Brynn, move 6 or more spaces in one turn  without using a maneuver action. Full of Stars As Chance, perform an attack with 5 or more  successes. Green Arrows As Galaden, give an enemy 5 different statuses in  one turn. Open Beta As Kehli, have 2 skill cards in other heroes’ play  areas at once. I Can Do This All Day As Syrus, discard 6 or more fatigue in one turn  without using consumables or flipping cards. Best Friend As Vaerix, grant healing, movement, positive  conditions, and/or surge abilities to each other  hero in the party in one round. (If playing with two  heroes, do this twice.) Ace on the River Flip 5 cards with one hero during one turn. Troupers Start a quest with each player using a different hero  than they used in the previous quest. Limited Edition Start a quest with two limited consumables  equipped to each hero. Runemaster Find or craft 6 Rune cards. Ashes to Ashes Burn down a barricade. But You Don’t Have to Take My  Word For It Find one of Brynn’s childhood favorites. Cat Burglars Over the course of a campaign, open 5 chests on  the first try. Well, Well, Well Over the course of a campaign, perform 3 different  heroes’ unique well interaction. This is Only the Beginning Complete Act I. Achievement List
